condition: When pd.read_parquet is called on a local path, pyarrow wraps a Python file handle in a PyReadableFile. If a ThreadPool worker drops the last reference while the interpreter is finalizing, the process can abort with SIGABRT at exit.
workaround: Use pyarrow.parquet.read_table(path, ...).to_pandas() instead of pd.read_parquet. That opens the file natively, so the reader holds no Python file object.
